name: Xtreme Fabrication
old_description: When it comes to metalworking and custom fabrication, Xtreme Fabrication won't leave you disappointed. Xtreme Fabrication is just one call or email away!
about:
Xtreme Fabrication operates from a 30,000-square-foot facility on five acres in Leitchfield, Kentucky. The company employs 20 people and holds ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication, offering MIG, TIG, and stick welding; CNC plasma and laser cutting up to 1-inch thickness; CNC pipe and tube bending up to 2-inch schedule 40 pipe; CNC press brake forming up to 350 tons and 12-foot length; CNC shearing; precision sawing with a Cosen automatic mitering saw; and CNC machining on five centers for runs of one to 4,000 pieces. Additional services include powder coating in what the company describes as the largest oven in central Kentucky, onsite installation, industrial maintenance, and emergency repair.

Xtreme Fabrication serves a range of industrial clients requiring weldment assemblies, complex formed parts, and machined components. The company emphasizes its role as a strategic outsourcing partner for customers needing low- to medium-volume production.

The company says it differentiates itself through a “keen sense of respect” for client time, budget, and needs, competitive pricing, and a quality program backed by a dedicated inspection area with granite surface plates, pin gauges, and 60-inch digital calipers.
